title: @ycforge/pilot — incremental builds CLI surface (spec 022)
description: Machine-readable contract for the incremental build cache CLI flags and --json summary.cache (spec 022, S-5..S-6, FR-018..024). Extends ycsf-cli.json (spec 021). Codes compared via constants in src/cli/errors.ts and src/cache/index.ts.

cacheSummary.title: CacheSummary (--json summary.cache)
cacheSummary.description: Structured cache stats for ycsf build|plan|apply --json (S-6, FR-023). Absent when cache not applicable (check/destroy/materialize).

hits.description: Count of apps that were cache hits in this invocation.

misses.description: Count of apps that were cache misses.

entries.description: Per-app entries in topologicalOrder build order.

fingerprint.description: Effective fingerprint (64-char lower-case hex sha256) computed for this run.

reason.description: First applicable miss reason (S-6, FR-011) or "hit".

cliFlags.title: Incremental-build CLI flags (S-5, FR-018..021)
cliFlags.description: Cache-related flags for ycsf build|plan|apply. Default: cache enabled (opt-out). Explicit only, no env/config toggle (Constitution V, FR-020).

noCache.description: When false (default) cache is enabled. Flag --no-cache sets true: bypass read and write (treat all as miss, but overwrite manifest/blobs after successful build). Available on build, plan, apply.

force.description: Alias for --no-cache (identical behavior, DX for npm/docker users). Either flag bypasses cache.

cacheDir.description: Override cache root (default .ycsf/cache relative to projectRoot). For tests/CI with ephemeral FS. Relative paths resolved from projectRoot. Ignored when --no-cache/--force.

build.description: ycsf build: before Builder.build() check effectiveFingerprint against manifest+blob; hit copies blobs/<fp>/ → artifacts/<appId>/ without builder call (FR-014).

target.description: Fingerprint computed only for target + its dependency closure (FR-021).

plan.description: ycsf plan: build phase cached (build → materialize → terraform plan). Materialize/terraform always run (not cached).

cache.description: Cache in build phase only; materialize/plan unchanged.

apply.description: ycsf apply: build phase cached as in plan (+ terraform apply).

destroy.description: ycsf destroy: no cache, does not touch .ycsf/cache/ (S-1).

observability.title: Cache observability (S-6, FR-022..024)
observability.description: Per-app hit/miss logging in stderr (human-readable) and summary.cache in --json.

humanReadable.description: When --json NOT set, stderr per-app line (one per app, before or instead of "Building app …"). Grep-stable.

hit.description: Example: "  • cache hit  user_service  (a1b2c3d4) — skipped build"

miss.description: Examples: "  • cache miss  analytics  (e5f6g7h8) — source changed" / " — dependency user_service changed" / " — --no-cache" / " — no cache entry" / "  ! cache corrupted for … — rebuilding"

json.description: When --json, stderr cache lines suppressed; summary.cache present (FR-023).

exitCodes.title: Cache vs project-model exit codes (S-7, FR-025..027)
exitCodes.description: Cache warnings never change exit code (fail-safe). Project model / builder failures remain fail-fast.

CACHE_CORRUPTED.description: Warning to stderr (CACHE_CORRUPTED / cache corrupted), treat as miss, exit 0 if build succeeded.

CACHE_BLOB_MISSING.description: Warning + miss, exit 0 if build succeeded.

CACHE_WRITE_FAILED.description: Warning on saveBlob/saveManifest failure, exit 0 (artifacts already valid).

CACHE_VERSION_MISMATCH.description: Warning + reset (all miss), exit 0 if build succeeded.

PML_DEPENDS_CYCLE.description: Fail-fast exit 1/2 before any cache I/O (FR-027).

CLI_BUILD_FAILED.description: Builder threw — fail-fast exit 1, cache not saved for failed app.
